verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's left-copy/right-product split with clear hierarchy (headline > body > CTA) and an intact bag image. Its only flaw is that the photo panel is inset, leaving thin, unintentional-looking dark strips on the top, right and bottom edges. B breaks up the design: the logo is blown up into a huge circle that competes with the headline, the product shot shrinks to a small cropped thumbnail, and the body copy is separated from the headline and squeezed into a narrow, awkwardly wrapped column at bottom center. The CTA is tiny and pushed to a corner, and there is large dead space at the upper left.
